title: Hold in Cover
condition: Control the Objective Zone and have at least 1 Soldier in Cover there.

title: Over the Top
condition: Have at least 3 Soldiers in the Objective Zone and/or enemy-side Zones.

title: Guns Silenced
condition: Destroy an enemy Machine Gun or Mortar this round.

title: Tank Hunter
condition: Destroy an enemy Tank this round.

title: No Shelter
condition: Have at least 3 Destroyed Cover tokens.

title: Shock Action
condition: Eliminate at least 3 enemy Soldiers with a single attack this round.

title: In the Wire
condition: Have at least 4 Soldiers in a single enemy-side Zone.

title: Dug In
condition: At the end of the round, have at least 3 Soldiers in Cover.

title: Breakthrough
condition: At the end of the round, control the Objective Zone and at least 1 enemy-side Zone.

title: Attrition
condition: Eliminate at least 5 enemy Soldiers this round.
